name: v4 + HSI futures night session (nf_move_atr, nf_imp_up_atr, nf_imp_lo_atr)

night_futures_rule.baseline_bar: last bar with time_key <= baseline 16:30:00, must be on baseline date and >= 16:00:00
night_futures_rule.cutoff_bar: last bar with time_key <= session 08:45:00, must be after baseline bar
night_futures_rule.fallback: missing/invalid -> throw; caller falls back to v4 (then v3)
